name: X Training
description: Training plans on your watch: 10K, half marathon or a VO2max block, built from your 5K time and run step by step with pace targets and alerts. Records your runs as X Run does.

configFields.label: Plan
configFields.description: 0 for no plan, 1 for 10K (10 weeks), 2 for half marathon (12 weeks), 3 for a VO2max block (8 weeks).

configFields.label: Your 5K time
configFields.description: A recent 5K, flat out, as minutes and seconds, e.g. 24:30. Your paces come from it.

configFields.label: 5K in the last 6 weeks
configFields.description: Off if your 5K is older: the plan then starts with a time-trial week to set your paces.

configFields.label: Half marathon time
configFields.description: Optional: a recent half, e.g. 1:52:00. It sets your half-marathon pace and easy pace.
configFields.validationMessage: Hours, minutes and seconds, e.g. 1:52:00, or leave it empty.

configFields.label: Race date
configFields.description: Optional: the race day, e.g. 2027-03-28. The plan is fitted to end with it. Empty starts the plan this week or next.
configFields.validationMessage: Year, month and day, e.g. 2027-03-28, or leave it empty.

configFields.label: Your running now
configFields.description: 1 up to 20 km (12 mi) a week, 2 about 20 to 40 km (12 to 25 mi), 3 over 40 km (25 mi).

configFields.label: Run on Monday
configFields.description: Tick the days you can run: 3 to 6 of them, your long-run day among them.

configFields.label: Run on Tuesday
configFields.description: Tick the days you can run: 3 to 6 of them, your long-run day among them.

configFields.label: Run on Wednesday
configFields.description: Tick the days you can run: 3 to 6 of them, your long-run day among them.

configFields.label: Run on Thursday
configFields.description: Tick the days you can run: 3 to 6 of them, your long-run day among them.

configFields.label: Run on Friday
configFields.description: Tick the days you can run: 3 to 6 of them, your long-run day among them.

configFields.label: Run on Saturday
configFields.description: Tick the days you can run: 3 to 6 of them, your long-run day among them.

configFields.label: Run on Sunday
configFields.description: Tick the days you can run: 3 to 6 of them, your long-run day among them.

configFields.label: Long run day
configFields.description: 1 for Monday to 7 for Sunday. It must be one of your run days.

configFields.label: Easy runs by heart rate
configFields.description: Easy and long runs aim for your watch's heart-rate zone 2 instead of a pace.
